title: Show HN: Unfenced – Land for sale that borders public land
summary: Unfenced.land is a niche real estate marketplace specifically for land parcels that border public lands such as national parks, forests, and BLM areas. It connects sellers of wilderness-adjacent properties with outdoor enthusiasts seeking privacy and direct access to public wilderness.
problem_solved: Solves the difficulty of discovering and purchasing rare land properties that border public wilderness areas.
why_valuable: Creates a specialized marketplace for a specific niche of land buyers who prioritize proximity to public lands for recreation, privacy, and natural access.
